title: Archive Attendant
subtitle: Keeper of the Ordered Shelves
bodyText: An archive attendant sorts bundles and returns each document to the place where it can be found. Quiet order gives the royal office a dependable memory, saving crucial words from the confusion of a crowded day.
sceneBrief: A humble archive attendant orders tied papyrus scroll bundles on wooden shelves in a Macedonian royal office, plain tunic and attentive expression.
rarityCharacteristics: plain iron, single rule, square corner joints
